summary: Franklin County, ME tower in Lang Plantation, dated 1916 and abandoned 1921 in a 2021 Sun Journal list; the FFLA list marks it gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it Tower Gone; no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: Sun Journal county list gives 1916 for Pickett Mountain, Lang Plantation
Same Sun Journal list says abandoned 1921

evidence.supports: Lang Plantation; tower dated 1916 and abandoned 1921
Franklin County tower listed as Tower Gone, with coordinates
2021 list is drawn from the association's Maine chapter
evidence.quote: Source: Forest Fire Lookout Association, Maine chapter

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Sun Journal list spells it Pickett Mountain; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list spells it Picket Mountain (Lang). The story uses the association spelling from our record.

sources.title: Maine fire towers: By the numbers

notes_for_editor: Two secondary sources only. The association list gives status and coordinates. The 2021 Sun Journal county list, which credits the association's Maine chapter, gives 1916 and 1921 and spells the name Pickett. No source read describes staffing, fires, or the site today. A Facebook search snippet ties the tower to East Kennebago Mountain in Lang township, but the fetched page was a different post, so it is not used. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 3 page reads.
